ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: SW — Weather Suite
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The generic engine half of WEATHER_SUITE_SLICE_1 — a fixed-geometry "arc from the substellar point" test any tidally-locked Star Wars planet could use unchanged (PlanetGeometryDef + MapComponent_TerminatorBand), a permanent terminator-front storm wall riding vanilla GameCondition_Flashstorm, and a nightside-gated dark-side aurora riding vanilla GameCondition_Aurora/ThoughtWorker_Aurora unchanged.
Campaign-specific wiring (Ash'karr's real substellar point and band arcs, folk-sign flavor text) lives in RimUtinni: Weather Suite (`mandrake.rut.weathersuite`). This mod carries no Ash'karr/clan/story references — see `design/NAMING_SCHEME_PLAN.md`'s engine/content split.
v1 slice only: terminator storms, dark-side auroras. Glass storms, static seasons, pressure tides, spore blooms and mirages are `design/Jawa/proposals/weather_suite_deep_design.md`'s v2/dream ladder, awaiting PROPOSAL_SUITE_REVIEW_1.
